extension.summary: Wyzie Subs: free subtitles in 80+ languages
extension.description: Subtitle service powered by Wyzie Subs (sub.wyzie.io). Subtitles from OpenSubtitles, IndexSubtitle and, on Pro keys, five more providers, through the Wyzie Subs API. Get a free API key at store.wyzie.io/redeem.
extension.news:
v1.0.3 - Security: downloads only come from sub.wyzie.io over https, subtitle files are always saved as wyzie.srt/.vtt/.ass/.ssa/.sub in the add-on folder, and the API key is kept out of the Kodi log
v1.0.2 - Finds the right title for TMDB-scraped movies and shows (reads the IMDb and TMDB ids separately; episodes use the show's id) - Manual search by title (e.g. "The Martian 2015" or "Severance S01E02") - Searches every provider your key allows (free: OpenSubtitles and IndexSubtitle) - "Prefer hearing-impaired" now lists SDH subtitles first instead of hiding the rest - Clear messages for a key on hold, Pro-only sources, used-up balance and the daily limit
